english.title: Buggery - boy under 16 years with boy under 16 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being under the age of 16 years, committed buggery with a boy **(..SPECIFY NAME..) under the age of 16, namely of the age of **(..SPECIFY AGE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) This offence may also be committed against a female. - see offence wording H2332.
(ii) If offence committed without the person's consent on or after 3.11.94 then charge rape.
(iii The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for buggery between two males where either is under the age of sixteen years.
(iv) This offence is included in Schedule 1(1) to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must (subject to the exceptions and provisions contained in Schedule 1(2) and (3)) comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(v) This offence is included in Schedule 2 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person committing this offence outside the United Kingdom may in certain circumstances be prosecuted for that offence in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
(vi) The age of consent was lowered to sixteen years on 8.1.01 by the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2000.
(vii) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
